title: Rate Card Supplement: Late-Fee Percentage Steps for Repeat Lateness, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Supplement to the parking rate card — repeat lateness.** On a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement, the late-fee percentage used for a late fee is stepped up by the agreement's record of uncorrected late fees:

| Late fees posted in the last 12 months that stand without a billing-error correction credit | Late-fee percentage used |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | the class's late-fee percentage plus 6 percentage points |
| exactly 1 | the class's late-fee percentage plus 3 percentage points |
| none | no step under this supplement |

The stepped percentage takes the place of the class's percentage in the percentage amount of the late fee: it is multiplied by the contracted monthly rent and that amount is rounded to the cent, before the flat late fee and the late-fee ceiling are applied to it.

**Counting.** Late fees corrected as billing errors are not counted: the count is the number of late fees posted on the agreement in the window less the number of billing-error correction credits posted on it in the window. A window of the last 12 months covers ledger entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month. The late fee now being worked out is not yet on the ledger and is not counted.

**Stepped percentages by class (class figure on the rate card, then with each step):**

| Space class | Class percentage | With 3-point step | With 6-point step |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 20% | 23% | 26% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 15% | 18% | 21% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 15% | 18% | 21% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 12% | 15% | 18% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 12% | 15% | 18% |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 10% | 13% | 16% |

Hypothetical reading: on a Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) at $300.00 with three late fees in the window, one of them carrying a billing-error correction credit, two stand uncorrected; 18% of $300.00 is $54.00, which lies between that class's $30.00 flat fee and $60.00 ceiling.
